assets.prompt: Generate ONE isolated blank combat status frame for Plants x Plants. Use both attached existing HUD assets as the authoritative style references: match their warm orange-brown wooden border, thin dark forest-green inner line, small gold corner fasteners, cream parchment interior and restrained green leaf sprigs. A compact horizontal rectangle approximately 3.2:1, matching a classic monster-battle name-and-health panel, reusable for either player's plant or opponent. Outer frame should be moderately slim, stepped pixel corners and crisp visible pixel art, no smooth vector edges. Small foliage only at upper-left and lower-right outer corners, never obstructing the inside. Interior must be ONE uninterrupted completely EMPTY opaque pale cream parchment area, large enough for plant name on top, health bar in middle, numbers beneath; do NOT actually draw any of those contents. No portrait slot, no internal dividers, no icons, no leaves inside the writing area. Match the supplied assets rather than inventing a different white/green minimalist frame. Center the entire panel with 8 percent fully transparent margin around all outside edges. Genuinely transparent background outside the frame; opaque cream inside the frame. No background scene, no characters, no words, no letters, no digits, no labels, no health bars, no progress tracks, no watermark, no checkerboard drawn into the artwork. Single standalone usable game UI sprite, not a sheet, not a collage, not a mockup screenshot. Shallow 2-3 tone pixel shading, no photorealism, no blur or dramatic cast shadow.

Create ONE isolated empty bottom command-panel frame for the turn-based plant battle in Plants x Plants. Match the two provided ACTUAL GAME HUD references exactly in design language: crisp pixel art, amber/orange brown wooden rails, dark forest-green thin inner keyline, small gold bolt heads and tiny green leaf sprigs only on outside corners, pale cream opaque parchment fill. This is a new battle-specific version of the horizontal dialogue panel: overall very wide horizontal rectangle about 5.5:1, single shared wooden outside border. One vertical wooden divider at 48 percent of the inner width: LEFT is one big completely blank cream message area. RIGHT is FOUR equally sized completely blank cream command-button compartments arranged precisely as a 2 columns by 2 rows grid. Thin matching timber separators in this right grid. All five interiors must be perfectly empty; no text, no placeholder writing, no icons, no leaves or portraits inside compartments. The main outer wooden border is slim enough to maximize usable interior. Restrained leaves only in top-left and bottom-right outside corners. Entire frame and corners visible with transparent padding, no clipping. Background outside panel is genuine alpha transparency; parchment INSIDE compartments stays opaque. Match the source HUD's broad long rectangular geometry, NOT a rounded modern card, NOT an ornate fantasy plaque. Coarse stepped square pixels, limited shading, no realistic wood grain or reflections, no blur. Absolutely no words, no letters, no numerals, no health bars, no screen background, no creatures, no watermark, no drawn checkerboard. One standalone compositable frame asset, not multiple panels or a sheet.

Generate ONE standalone empty rectangular action-button frame sprite for Plants x Plants, matching the attached actual game interaction HUD asset. Same cozy pixel-art amber brown wood, dark green inner line, little golden corner studs, pale cream opaque interior. Horizontal rectangle about 3:1, simple stepped/chamfered corners. Much slimmer wooden edge than a large message frame, suitable for a clickable move button with dynamic name and information drawn in code later. Only one tiny restrained green leaf sprig at the upper-left outer corner, occupying very little space. A fully blank uninterrupted cream interior with no dividers or icons. Match the visible coarse pixel grid and warm palette of the reference, not modern vector UI, not photorealism. Centered on transparent canvas with clear padding on all four sides; transparent exterior, opaque cream interior. No text, letters, numbers, symbols, arrows, portraits, health bars, progress tracks, or characters. No multiple states, no sheet, no mockup, no backdrop, no drop shadow outside the outline, no watermark. ONE reusable blank button frame only.
